files.adapted_why: Adapted for this repo; every deviation from the kit is listed in the PERMUTO ADAPTATIONS block at the top of the file: `tidy` runs against this repo's own .clang-tidy (the bug-finding subset — clang-diagnostic-* + clang-analyzer-*, 0 findings, 104-201 s; the two heavier rule sets and why they were rejected are in INCIDENTS.md), stage_version also compares the generated $CI_BUILD_DIR/*ConfigVersion.cmake (a third copy of the version number no kit stage looks at), Permuto's own defaults (CI_VERSION_BINARIES, CI_DEFAULT_STAGES) are set by plain assignment after the kit's block, and --help derives its header range from the PERMUTO ADAPTATIONS marker because the kit's first-blank-line rule would cut the local notes off. The only byte difference that is NOT a Permuto decision is a literal newline inside one printf format string in write_tidy_baseline() (output-identical; all four ports of the 2026-09-20 tidy-baseline fix carry it). The kit's tidy-baseline fix itself (tidy_key on both operands + --write-tidy-baseline) was ported in here by cbb7248, so this copy is not lagging the kit. **2026-09-20, card t_0a9a0018:** the prologue gained `unset GIT_INDEX_FILE` — the kit's own line now (kit f9c3300), with the mechanism and the measurement in the comment above it: git exports its TEMPORARY index to the pre-commit hook for a `git commit -- <path>`, and any `git` command this gate runs inside ANOTHER repository then reads this repo's index entries against that repository's object store and dies on the first blob it does not have. Permuto's exposure is stated honestly in the gate's own comment rather than implied: its CMakeLists.txt uses find_package(GTest) and no FetchContent, so no stage of it runs git outside this checkout TODAY. The line is here because the class is general and this copy already contains an instance of it — tools/kit-probes/ runs git in throwaway repos by design (that is how the kit's probes work).

The stage list is the kit's own verbatim (--require-clean tree format kitprobes build tests version asan tsan tidy pristine); the only difference is the nine-line PERMUTO comment above the exec, which records what `tidy` certifies here (.clang-tidy's bug-finding subset) and where the clean-tree check lived while the `tree` stage could not pass.

Permuto's real config: CI_DEFAULT_STAGES spelled out with tidy included, CI_VERSION_BINARIES=$CI_BUILD_DIR/permuto, the note that the third version copy (the generated *ConfigVersion.cmake) deliberately has no knob, the kit's optional CI_ASAN_TEST_CMD example block absent (nothing here filters the suite under a sanitizer: `grep -rn GTEST_FILTER tests/ .ci.env.example` finds nothing, and there is no RSS-measuring or wall-clock test), and a PERMUTO NOTES section at the end recording what is wired, the rule set `tidy` runs and the two heavier rule sets rejected with their measured numbers.
